kjv: he (the one taken with the devoted things) hath wrought folly in Israel
mine: has done an outrageous thing in Israel
note: Nevalah denotes a disgraceful, sacrilegious outrage against the community, not mere foolishness as "folly" now suggests.

kjv: burned them (Achan and all he had) with fire, after they (all Israel) had stoned them with stones
mine: they (all Israel) burned them (Achan and all he had) with fire and stoned them with stones
note: The Hebrew simply has two coordinate clauses (vayyisrefu ... vayyisqelu); KJV turns the second into a prior action ("after"), imposing a sequence the text does not state.
